There is no account, no sign-up and no advertising.
We do not use analytics or tracking tools, and we do not sell or share personal data.
The load planner, CBM calculator, label tools, checkers and calculators work on your phone or computer. Your cargo details and the documents you check stay on your device.

{0}. Information that stays on your device
To work well, the app keeps a few small items on your device:
your recent tracking searches, so you can repeat them quickly;
the results you choose to save, your
list (numbers, labels, ETAs and notes), and the details you type into the invoice and packing list maker and its checklist, so you do not have to enter them again;
small notes that you have already seen a notice, cleared when you close the app;
{0}. Information sent when you use live tools

When the app or site loads a page, your device connects to our hosting provider, Cloudflare. As with any website, this connection includes your IP address, browser type, the page requested and the time. Cloudflare processes this to deliver and protect the site, under its own privacy policy.

The duty calculator and export benefit finder fetch current exchange rates from our server and from public rate services (frankfurter.dev and open.er-api.com). The Trade Desk fetches public news and government notices. These requests contain no personal information beyond the normal connection details above.
Some pages load fonts from Google Fonts, which receives normal connection details.
{0}. Information you choose to send us

If you ask us to review a Material Safety Data Sheet, you send us the file together with your name and email address and, if you wish, your company, phone number and HS code. We store these securely to answer your request and to follow up about that shipment. We accept the upload only after you tick the consent box.

If you turn on alerts in My shipments, you give us your email address or WhatsApp number, and we confirm it with a one-time code. We then store that contact together with the shipment numbers, labels and ETA dates in your list, in access-controlled storage. We use them only to send you reminders before and after your ETA. Emails are sent through our email provider (Resend) and WhatsApp messages through Meta’s WhatsApp Business Platform, which handle your address or number to deliver the message under their own privacy policies.
